_comment: Glob/regex rules that assign every extracted file to exactly one group.
First match wins; a file that matches nothing gets `default`.
Groups follow docs/SPEC_PIANO.md: boot, menu, character:<name>, stage:<name>,
music, movies, other. A rule may use a named-group regex instead of a glob,
and its group string may substitute the capture, e.g. "character:{name}".
UNVERIFIED AGAINST THE REAL DISC: these paths are the ones the plan expects,
but no ISO exists yet, so whether they classify the real filesystem correctly
is unknown (docs/PLAN_BREAKDOWN.md T8, docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md Q1). The manifest
generator fails loudly on a group string outside the grammar, and the test suite
only asserts these rules against synthetic names.
